title: AINumbers agent feedback report (ain-agent-feedback-v0)
description: Normative schema for unauthenticated, enum-only agent feedback reports POSTed to https://mcp.ainumbers.co/feedback. Reports carry structural metadata only: no free text, no conversation content, no personal data. v0 is PRE-STABLE: fields may be added or removed before v1.0, and consumers MUST ignore unknown members; this schema therefore never sets additionalProperties to false. This document is the definitions surface for reporting agents: every enum value carries a description and one canonical example. Authored in-house 2026-09-24; the W3C Reporting API and the bandarra.me agent-feedback sketch are cited as inspiration, not implemented text (no bytes copied).

schema_version.description: Wire discriminator naming the report dialect. v0 is pre-stable: consumers MUST ignore unknown members and MUST NOT attempt to interpret a schema_version they do not implement.

report.description: The feedback report body. Pre-stable v0: members may be added or removed before v1.0; consumers MUST ignore unknown members rather than rejecting them.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool the agent was invoking, in the estate's mcp_name vocabulary: lowercase snake_case, starting with a letter, at most 128 characters. Send the exact name as attempted; whether that name is registered is collector-side knowledge, never a reporter assertion.

doorway.description: Which access path produced the failure being reported.

oneOf.description: A WebMCP page tool executing inside the browser page (the agent selected a page-registered tool and the page ran it).
A versioned deep link (a #p=v1... fragment URL) reached without a registered page-tool invocation.
A worker-served MCP tool invoked over the /mcp endpoint at mcp.ainumbers.co.
The reporter cannot determine which doorway produced the failure. Send this rather than guessing.

failure_class.description: Coarse class of the failure, enumerable in v1; the weekly digest aggregates on this field, so a value outside the enumeration is a validation error, not free text.

oneOf.description: The tool rejected the arguments supplied: a validation or policy-parameter failure detected before execution started.
The requested tool does not exist, has been removed, or is not visible to the caller.
The tool was found and accepted its arguments, but the execution itself failed or returned an error result.
The execution hash observed differs from the hash the reporter expected: a divergence between claimed and verified output.
The agent could not determine how to call the tool correctly from the published schema or documentation, so it never produced a valid call.
None of the enumerated classes applies. The digest reports this class separately and reviews a majority share before acting on it.

expected_hash.description: OPTIONAL. Execution hash the reporter expected, lowercase hexadecimal, 1 to 64 characters. Omit the member entirely when the reporter holds no expectation to compare against.

observed_hash.description: OPTIONAL. Execution hash the reporter observed, lowercase hexadecimal, 1 to 64 characters. Send only when an execution actually produced output to hash.

agent_label.description: OPTIONAL. Short printable-ASCII label describing the reporting agent, at most 64 characters. Advisory self-description only: it is never authenticated and never republished per-report.

occurred_at.description: OPTIONAL. RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time of the observed failure. Omit the member rather than guessing a time.
